summary.intent: Execute all 22 plans of phase 68.1 (web client runtime integration) via wave-based orchestration, then diagnose and close verification gaps (SHARE-WRITE-KEY wiring, cold-reload IPNS navigation, text-editor decryption, e2e failures) until the phase's success criteria are met.
summary.outcome: All 22 plans (14 initial + 8 gap-closure) executed across 10 waves with wave gates green; e2e suite improved from 6/208 to 195/208 passing over two rounds. Multiple real bugs found and fixed (folder-store id desync, kind-cache never consulted in shared browser, createFolder missing TEE republish enrollment, D-05 stale-record retry direction, text-editor readKey misuse, SHARE-WRITE-KEY recipient wiring), but the exit-gate agent died on the account session limit mid-triage; orchestrator manually recovered and committed the remaining uncommitted work before re-spawning phase verification.

repo: gsd execute-phase orchestrator spawns per-plan subagents in git worktrees, records worktree metadata in a wave manifest, then merges all worktrees for a wave together before running post-merge build/test gates
createFolder in packages/sdk/src/client.ts must include encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch on publish or subfolders never get enrolled in ipns_republish_schedule (durability gap, fixed in 68.1-16)

mock-ipns-routing dev container stores IPNS records in an in-memory Map — any restart wipes unpublished-to-DB records permanently, causing cold-navigation 404 loops that look like propagation timeouts (GAP-2 was actually a wipe, not lag)

client.downloadFromIpns / resolveFileMetadata expects the file's own readKey, not the parent folderKey — passing folderKey silently type-checks (both Uint8Array) but AEAD-fails at decrypt time; must recover file readKey via unsealChildReadKey off the SealedChildRef first (same pattern as 68.1-04)

migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover dropped the shares table's plaintext item_name column entirely, making share.service.ts's toSentShare/toReceivedShare hardcode itemName:'' and the REQ-4 backfill feature permanently dead code (GAP-6, documented not fixed — reviving would violate zero-knowledge)

the live /shares REST API grants an entire subtree via one ECIES wrap of the root readKey — there is no per-child key field, so collectChildKeys/ChildKeyDto design is unused by real callers (resolveChildNodeIdentity is used directly instead)

sdk-core's issueReadGrant/claimInvite (grant.ts) produce base64 payloads but the live DTOs are hex-only; web code must call wrapKey/unwrapKey directly with hex encoding instead of routing through sdk-core's grant primitives

full-workflow.spec.ts is describe.serial — a failure early (e.g. nested folder creation) skips 50+ downstream tests, so raw failed-count numbers understate real coverage/health until deep serial specs actually complete

mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck used busybox `wget localhost` which resolves to ::1 (IPv6) while the app binds IPv4-only, causing perpetual 'unhealthy' status despite the service actually working — fix is `127.0.0.1` in the healthcheck

code.finding: createFolder now enrolls new subfolders in TEE republish (encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch) fail-closed before any addToIpfs side effect (68.1-16); also gained resolveFileIpnsPrivateKey public method and reworked moveInSharedFolder to resolve destination keys via one-hop write-chain walk when share_keys is empty (68.1-20)
hardcoded isFolder = true stub meant the D-02 kind cache was never consulted in the shared browser — replaced with isFolder = !isFileRef(item) (68.1-15)
updateFileMetadata never actually zeroed fileIpnsPrivateKey despite doc comments claiming it did (T-47-01 latent bug, fixed in 68.1-12)
retry loop treated all ReconcileStaleError the same; fixed to only retry when network sequence is ahead of local, routing network-behind-local straight to the D-05 rejection toast (GAP-4, 68.1-21)

workflow: Background subagents can silently stop reporting ('lost wake') when their session is evicted after a long-running background shell finishes — orchestrator should arm an independent watchdog (polling for output artifacts like .last-run.json) as a backstop and resume the agent via SendMessage with concrete results rather than assume it will wake on its own

When a subagent's task-notification result is truncated/garbled (e.g. reports 'expected_base' as its own docs commit instead of the true fork point), verify the actual git fork point manually before trusting metadata for merge/recording
Running full e2e/build test gates from parallel subagents concurrently can starve RAM — run centrally/sequentially per prior project memory
Piped stdout from a background Bash task isn't visible via process fd inspection; must read the harness's own captured task-file for live progress instead of chasing the process's file descriptors
When session token/quota limit kills an agent mid-work, manually inspect uncommitted diffs and validate (build/test) before committing, since the agent may have left an in-progress fix uncommitted

friction: Wave 1 agent for plan 68.1-01 stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls with no explicit completion signal, requiring a spot-check fallback and background resume

Exit-gate agent (68.1-13, and again 68.1-22) repeatedly failed to wake automatically after its long-running background e2e suite finished, losing significant wall-clock time until the orchestrator's watchdog/manual check caught it
Decision-coverage gate required exact tag placement (`- **D-04 [informational]:**` inside the bold ID group) — initial attempts at tagging D-04 as informational silently failed to register
git index.lock transient contention during Wave 3 tracking commit required a retry
A subagent (68.1-16) mistakenly ran a prohibited `git stash push`/never popped, leaving a stray stash entry that had to be identified and dropped during cleanup
Bash tool permission denial when reading .env-adjacent compose config required splitting the command to avoid the blocked read
Exit-gate agent (68.1-22) died on account session limit mid-triage, losing in-flight work that had to be manually recovered, validated, and committed by the orchestrator
User's manual testing (logout/login navigation, text-editor decrypt) repeatedly surfaced real bugs the 208-spec e2e suite structurally could not reach due to serial-spec early aborts
open_items: GAP-6: REQ-4 itemName backfill is dead code post-schema-cutover (item_name column dropped) — needs a deliberate feature-retirement or redesign decision, not a unilateral fix
enumerateSharedSubtree (shared-move destination picker) still rides the now-empty share_keys fan-out and returns an empty picker list — follow-up plan needed
conflict-detection e2e spec still fails at the same spot even after the 'adopt published state after every publish' fix (3cdf20e28) — needs further investigation
rotation-durability SC-4 and recovery IPFS-direct v2 blob remain as residual e2e failures

Any file uploaded to the dev vault before the fileReadKey seal fix has a permanently mis-sealed parent ref and will still fail to decrypt — data damage in dev vault, not a code bug, needs manual cleanup or re-upload
